answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 39815 Country: Pakistan Title: I am a student of first year (Ula Darja) I am having problem in memory Question: I am a student of first year (Ula Darja) I am having problem in memory. My memory is weak. Please tell me any wazifah to increase memory or any method to increase memory. I am much disturbed. I will be waiting for your response. Answer ID: 39815 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1008/603/L=1433) Recite Ya Qavi (يا قوى) 11 times after each salah putting your hand on your forehead. And use any Majoon which sharpens the memory with the advice of any Hakim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
